name: Fred Hoetmer
reviewBody: We are very pleased with the high quality of work and professionalism from Final Finish Epoxy. The care and detail from Denis and  his team is exceptional. From the prep work to the final top coat you can see the pride they take in their work. The epoxy floor looks amazing finishing off our garage. Other trades people working on our home comment on the outstanding quality of Denis’s work. It was very positive dealing Denis and would highly recommend Final Finish Epoxy.

name: Nate Whalen
reviewBody: Amazing job completed by Denis and his team. The pride and care in their workmanship from planning to completion shows in the finished product. Super knowledgeable and absolutely nailed the custom coloring to match the paint. Highly recommend if you are looking for a professionally done floor!

name: sameer jadavji
reviewBody: Denis and his team did an amazing job in our garage! We are thrilled with the results and would definitely recommend his services to others.

name: Marrabout 123
reviewBody: I recently had my garage floor redone by this epoxy flooring company, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the experience was smooth and professional. The pricing was fair and competitive, and what really stood out was the owner, Denis. He personally worked on the project and clearly takes a lot of pride in his craft—everything was done with great care and attention to detail. Unlike many contractors I’ve dealt with in the past, Denis and his team were punctual, reliable, and finished the job exactly when they said they would. I didn’t have to chase anyone down or worry about delays. It was a completely stress-free process, and the end result looks fantastic. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone considering epoxy flooring.

name: Glenda Clarke
reviewBody: We recently hired Denis and his crew to epoxy the floors in both our campground bathrooms and the bathrooms in our main complex, and couldn't be happier with the results. The project turned out to be more work than expected, particularly in the complex bathrooms where multiple layers of old flooring had to be removed.  Denis took the time to do the job right, ensuring the surface was properly prepared before applying the epoxy. He was professional, reliable, and easy to work with throughout the entire process.  The finished floors look fantastic, and they will stand up to years of use in our facility. We truly appreciate the extra effort and attention to detail that went into this project and would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone.

name: Andrew McCready
reviewBody: I was very pleased with the price, process, and result. I found Denis on a Facebook ad, and he gave me a great quote, did a thorough prep job, patched some cracks, and then did a fantastic job on the epoxy, flake and top coat. I would definitely recommend Denis.
